rules.memoryDeletionGate: Deleting Sibyl Memory must cause the claimed core function to fail or materially degrade. The video must show fresh-session recall, the README must point to critical reads and writes, and a deletion test must demonstrate the break.
rules.pmfBonus: Up to 10 points; nonzero requires a publicly verifiable artifact showing a named audience and validated pain point, usage, pilot, waitlist, or design partner.
rules.partnerMultiplier: Base or Virtuals count only when doing real product work in the demo. Base deployment is the eligibility floor; an executed on-chain action earns its bonus. First partner +15%, second +10%, capped at 1.25x.
rules.mainnetRequirement: The rules require an executed on-chain action for the Base bonus; they do not expressly say that it must be on mainnet. This project specification independently requires Base mainnet attestations.
rules.submissionRequirements: Public OSI-licensed GitHub repository with real commit history; 2–5 minute demo including fresh-session recall; README; two public posts.
